rules.flash_sales: One product per sale; online unit; percentage or fixed unit discount; optional total quantity limit; best active overlapping sale wins.
rules.coupons: One code per order; case insensitive; percentage or fixed merchandise discount after flash pricing; optional total usage limit and minimum subtotal.
rules.duration: Optional start and end independently; edited in business timezone and stored/checked in UTC; inclusive start, exclusive end.
rules.limits: Count placed orders/quantities, including cancelled orders; retry keys count once; checkout and admin writes share a storefront row lock.
rules.history: Order prices, coupon allocations and promotion names/codes are snapshotted; deleting archives a promotion.
rules.positive_totals: Discounts preserve at least one currency unit in merchandise totals to match payment contracts.
